subject: Mobile Development
title: 4G and the Streaming Era
description: A fast breakdown of 4G and the Streaming Era for builders.

hook.text: 3G made mobile internet possible. 4G made it fast enough to stream video.

buildup.text: 4G LTE offered speeds 10 times faster than 3G, rivaling home broadband connections.

discovery.text: YouTube, Netflix, and Spotify became mobile-first experiences thanks to 4G speeds.

twist.text: Data consumption exploded. Users burned through gigabytes without realizing it.

climax.text: 4G turned phones from communication devices into portable entertainment centers.

punchline.text: Fast data turned phones into TVs.

quiz.question: What did 4G enable on mobile phones?
